description:
The Platform Engineer is responsible for designing, automating, governing, and optimizing the technical platforms, environments, and infrastructure supporting software implementations.

 The role leverages AI-assisted platform operations, automation, predictive monitoring, and intelligent infrastructure management to improve scalability, consistency, and operational reliability.

  

 Primary Purpose 

  

 To ensure intelligent, automated, secure, and scalable platform operations across the implementation lifecycle.

  

 Key Responsibilities 

  

 Platform Engineering

 
 Design implementation environments

 Define infrastructure architecture standards

 Govern platform configuration standards

 Support deployment and operational readiness

 
  

 AI-Assisted Platform Operations

 
 Leverage AI-assisted environment provisioning

 Utilize predictive operational monitoring

 Implement intelligent platform automation

 Govern AI-powered operational recommendations

 
  

 Infrastructure Automation

 
 Develop Infrastructure-as-Code practices

 Automate environment lifecycle management

 Standardize deployment processes

 Improve operational consistency

 
  

 Platform Governance

 
 Ensure platform security compliance

 Monitor operational performance

 Govern platform standards

 Manage platform resilience strategies

 
  

 Operational Intelligence

 
 Utilize predictive performance analytics

 Leverage AI-powered monitoring tools

 Proactively identify operational risks

 Optimize platform performance

 
  

 Required Competencies 

  

 Platform Expertise

 
 Infrastructure management

 Cloud technologies

 Platform architecture

 Security and compliance

 Performance management

 
  

 Platform Intelligence

 
 AI-assisted operations

 Intelligent monitoring

 Predictive analytics

 Infrastructure automation

 Operational governance

 
  

 Engineering Practices

 
 Infrastructure-as-Code

 Automation frameworks

 Platform resilience

 Continuous improvement

 Operational excellence

 
  

 Success Measures 

  

 
 Environment provisioning speed

 Platform reliability

 Automation adoption

 Infrastructure consistency

 Operational efficiency

 Security compliance

 Customer deployment success

 
  

 

  

  

 
  
 InterSystems is providing a current good faith estimate of the anticipated base salary range for this position depending on a variety of factors including experience, education, skills, and performance. 

 Other compensation may include a discretionary annual variable target incentive. 

 The company also provides generous employee benefits including: 

 
 Health Insurance 

 Lunch Vouchers 

 
 The estimated base compensation range for this role is:
 €42.000 — €60.000 EUR 


 About InterSystems 

 InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit  InterSystems.com .

  

 AI Disclaimer 

 InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information).  InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines . AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees.

 Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience.  AI tools and third-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments.

 Please note that the use of wearable technology, including any AI-related tools or other technology-connected devices (such as META or Google smart glasses and/or wearables, and/or any similar devices), is   strictly prohibited   during the interview and screening process with InterSystems.  Any applicant who requires a wearable device or any type of technology support during the interview process as a reasonable accommodation under the ADA or applicable state or country laws and regulations must contact the InterSystems Human Resources Department   prior to attending or participating in any interview or screening process.
